descriptions.d24i_grid_scan_alt_8010d0a0: Variant of the grid cell scan 0x8010c494 using edge test 0x8010bda0 and triangles 0x8010b43c, reading corners without a header offset: for each passing cell seeks the run-length cursor at +28 and draws corners +2, +74, +1298 with flag 0 and +74, +1298, +1370 with flag 1.
